peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 3.7% below its local comparables; 18 of 44 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (53.9): 5 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 27 of 51 similar developments (the same as 1). Context, not scored: resales in 87.5% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $933,000 ($2,064 psf, 452 sq ft; 8 resales, Jul 2024–Jun 2026); 6 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,075 psf (range $1,951–2,267); 0.5% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $5,000 less. 2-bedroom: median $1,645,000 ($2,247 psf, 731 sq ft; 12 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 7 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,338 psf (range $1,973–2,732); 3.9% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $67,000 less. 3-bedroom: median $2,183,888 ($2,223 psf, 861–1,474 sq ft; 13 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 6 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,381 psf (range $2,035–2,991); 6.6% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $155,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Redhill MRT about 140 m, Tiong Bahru MRT about 1,150 m; closer than 41 of 51 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest Gan Eng Seng Primary School about 610 m; more than 24 of 51 similar developments (the same as 23). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 5 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 420 m), more than 21 of 51 similar developments (the same as 6); nearest hawker centre Redhill Market about 310 m; nearest park Tiong Bahru Park about 580 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Penrith, 457 new sales, about 1,180 m; Upperhouse at Orchard Boulevard, 47 new sales, about 1,440 m; Grange 1866, 6 new sales, about 1,610 m; Park Nova, 4 new sales, about 1,690 m; Promenade Peak, 99 new sales, about 1,700 m; Zyon Grand, 637 new sales, about 1,760 m; River Green, 34 new sales, about 1,770 m; River Modern, 431 new sales, about 1,900 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 156 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,715 new sales and 859 resales (2,574 purchases); new sales were 66.6% of these purchases. Subsales (8) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 859 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 42 of 51 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 859 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,042 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−17.6%). Planning-area private resales −18%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
